answer_prose: For runners with an earlier best of 3:30–4 hours, the middle 80% of outcomes spans 16.3 percentage points in the faster-opening group and 29.2 in the slower-opening group. These are outcome ranges, not confidence intervals or causal strategy effects.
detail_prose: The spread is grouped by prior performance, while the second chart records finishes more than 5% slower than that prior benchmark.
